import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path(sys.argv[1])
receipts = Path(sys.argv[2])
baseline = json.loads((receipts / 'baseline-text.json').read_text())
manifest = json.loads((receipts / 'baseline.json').read_text())
texts = {name: (repo / name).read_text() for name in baseline}
readme = 'docs/process/omp/README.md'
planning = 'docs/process/omp/planning-loop.md'
implementation = 'docs/process/omp/implementation-loop.md'
adapter = 'docs/process/omp/herdr.md'
smoke = 'docs/plans/2026-10-20-omp-herdr-dispatch.md'
plan = 'docs/plans/2026-10-22-omp-herdr-external-control.md'

# Outside the replaced Herdr section, every README byte stays unchanged.
assert texts[readme].split('### Herdr workers from native Tern')[0] == baseline[readme].split('### When running inside Herdr')[0]
assert texts[readme].split('## Roles and session choices', 1)[1] == baseline[readme].split('## Roles and session choices', 1)[1]

# Each loop differs only in its single route-selection paragraph.
for name in (planning, implementation):
    old_lines = baseline[name].splitlines(keepends=True)
    new_lines = texts[name].splitlines(keepends=True)
    assert len(old_lines) == len(new_lines)
    changed = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(old_lines, new_lines) if a != b]
    assert len(changed) == 1 and changed[0][0].startswith('Select the dispatch route')
    assert changed[0][1].startswith('Select the dispatch route')

# Preserve the original frozen smoke-plan text and reference exactly.
assert texts[smoke].startswith(baseline[smoke])
assert texts[smoke][len(baseline[smoke]):].startswith('\n## 2026-10-22 amendment: native-Tern smoke origin\n')
assert '988d3917890ddf56b48b950afa2c162dd84c8c4e' in texts[smoke][len(baseline[smoke]):]

# Preserve the adapter's policy paragraphs not affected by targeting/location.
for line in baseline[adapter].splitlines():
    if line.startswith(('Use Herdr for reviewer', '`agent start` uses', 'Before parallel starts', 'Keep the name, returned pane IDs', 'If a completed report is missing')):
        assert line in texts[adapter], line

# All relative links/heading anchors resolve. Ignore angle-bracket CLI templates.
resolved_links = 0
for name, text in texts.items():
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        file_part, sep, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = (repo / name).parent / file_part if file_part else repo / name
        assert dest.exists(), (name, target)
        if sep:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = {re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings}
            assert anchor in slugs, (name, target, slugs)
        resolved_links += 1

# Executable Herdr pane/agent templates pin both session and pane identity.
for line in texts[adapter].splitlines():
    command = line.strip()
    if command.startswith('herdr ') and (' pane ' in command or ' agent ' in command):
        assert command.startswith('herdr --session <verified-existing-session> '), command
        assert '<authorized-base-pane-id>' in command or '<returned-pane-id>' in command, command
        assert '--current' not in command
        if any(term in command for term in (' agent start ', ' agent wait ', ' pane wait-output ')) or '--wait' in command:
            assert re.search(r'--timeout [1-9][0-9]*\b', command), command

# No current route still requires an inside-Herdr coordinator.
for name in (readme, planning, implementation):
    assert 'ask them to launch OMP there' not in texts[name]
    assert 'ask for a genuine Herdr-pane continuation' not in texts[name]
    assert 'keep Sol/OMP native in Tern' in texts[name]
assert 'test "${HERDR_ENV:-}" = 1' not in texts[adapter]
assert 'system/runtime restrictions' in texts[adapter]
assert 'does **not** authorize a live smoke' in texts[adapter]
assert 'documented/unverified' in texts[readme] and 'documented/unverified' in texts[adapter]

# No unapproved tracked/untracked file has changed, appeared or disappeared.
names = set(filter(None, subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=repo).decode().split('\0')))
assert names == set(manifest['files'])
allowed = set(baseline)
changed_paths = []
for name in sorted(names):
    path = repo / name
    digest = {'symlink': str(path.readlink())} if path.is_symlink() else hashlib.file_digest(path.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
    if digest != manifest['files'][name]:
        changed_paths.append(name)
        assert name in allowed, name
assert plan not in changed_paths, 'Frozen amendment must remain untouched until its append-only execution receipt'

Classify behavior, not file extension. Low risk means obvious low-impact typos/links/formatting: coordinator inspection and gates suffice. Normal work needs one independent reviewer at planning and final review. High risk (permissions, workflow contracts, compatibility, data formats, path resolution, exit codes, or load-bearing behavior) needs two independent reviewers at both stages unless the user explicitly authorizes an exception. Use fresh contexts and separate roles; for High risk require verified distinct model families, or disclose unverified identities and obtain explicit acceptance of the named pair. If you believe a change is required, do not make it. Report it instead.

```

Require `EFFECTIVE_MODEL` (requested/configured/settings/modes/evidence; upstream verified or unverified), `VERDICT` (`pass | changes_required | unverified`), `BLOCKERS` (location, problem, expected behavior, evidence), `SUGGESTIONS`, `FILES_AT_RISK`, and `CONCEDED`. import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path(sys.argv[1])
receipts = Path(sys.argv[2])
baseline = json.loads((receipts / 'baseline-text.json').read_text())
manifest = json.loads((receipts / 'baseline.json').read_text())
texts = {name: (repo / name).read_text() for name in baseline}
readme = 'docs/process/omp/README.md'
planning = 'docs/process/omp/planning-loop.md'
implementation = 'docs/process/omp/implementation-loop.md'
adapter = 'docs/process/omp/herdr.md'
smoke = 'docs/plans/2026-10-20-omp-herdr-dispatch.md'
plan = 'docs/plans/2026-10-22-omp-herdr-external-control.md'

# Outside the replaced Herdr section, every README byte stays unchanged.
assert texts[readme].split('### Herdr workers from native Tern')[0] == baseline[readme].split('### When running inside Herdr')[0]
assert texts[readme].split('## Roles and session choices', 1)[1] == baseline[readme].split('## Roles and session choices', 1)[1]

# Each loop differs only in its single route-selection paragraph.
for name in (planning, implementation):
    old_lines = baseline[name].splitlines(keepends=True)
    new_lines = texts[name].splitlines(keepends=True)
    assert len(old_lines) == len(new_lines)
    changed = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(old_lines, new_lines) if a != b]
    assert len(changed) == 1 and changed[0][0].startswith('Select the dispatch route')
    assert changed[0][1].startswith('Select the dispatch route')

# Preserve the original frozen smoke-plan text and reference exactly.
assert texts[smoke].startswith(baseline[smoke])
assert texts[smoke][len(baseline[smoke]):].startswith('\n## 2026-10-22 amendment: native-Tern smoke origin\n')
assert '988d3917890ddf56b48b950afa2c162dd84c8c4e' in texts[smoke][len(baseline[smoke]):]

# Preserve the adapter's policy paragraphs not affected by targeting/location.
for line in baseline[adapter].splitlines():
    if line.startswith(('Use Herdr for reviewer', '`agent start` uses', 'Before parallel starts', 'Keep the name, returned pane IDs', 'If a completed report is missing')):
        assert line in texts[adapter], line

# All relative links/heading anchors resolve. Ignore angle-bracket CLI templates.
resolved_links = 0
for name, text in texts.items():
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        file_part, sep, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = (repo / name).parent / file_part if file_part else repo / name
        assert dest.exists(), (name, target)
        if sep:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = {re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings}
            assert anchor in slugs, (name, target, slugs)
        resolved_links += 1

# Executable Herdr pane/agent templates pin both session and pane identity.
for line in texts[adapter].splitlines():
    command = line.strip()
    if command.startswith('herdr ') and (' pane ' in command or ' agent ' in command):
        assert command.startswith('herdr --session <verified-existing-session> '), command
        assert '<authorized-base-pane-id>' in command or '<returned-pane-id>' in command, command
        assert '--current' not in command
        if any(term in command for term in (' agent start ', ' agent wait ', ' pane wait-output ')) or '--wait' in command:
            assert re.search(r'--timeout [1-9][0-9]*\b', command), command

# No current route still requires an inside-Herdr coordinator.
for name in (readme, planning, implementation):
    assert 'ask them to launch OMP there' not in texts[name]
    assert 'ask for a genuine Herdr-pane continuation' not in texts[name]
    assert 'keep Sol/OMP native in Tern' in texts[name]
assert 'test "${HERDR_ENV:-}" = 1' not in texts[adapter]
assert 'system/runtime restrictions' in texts[adapter]
assert 'does **not** authorize a live smoke' in texts[adapter]
assert 'documented/unverified' in texts[readme] and 'documented/unverified' in texts[adapter]

# No unapproved tracked/untracked file has changed, appeared or disappeared.
names = set(filter(None, subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=repo).decode().split('\0')))
assert names == set(manifest['files'])
allowed = set(baseline)
changed_paths = []
for name in sorted(names):
    path = repo / name
    digest = {'symlink': str(path.readlink())} if path.is_symlink() else hashlib.file_digest(path.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
    if digest != manifest['files'][name]:
        changed_paths.append(name)
        assert name in allowed, name
assert plan not in changed_paths, 'Frozen amendment must remain untouched until its append-only execution receipt'
print(json.dumps({'result': 'pass', 'relative_links_and_anchors': resolved_links, 'changed_paths': changed_paths, 'protected_policy': 'unchanged', 'original_smoke_plan': 'preserved exactly', 'live_smoke': 'not run'}, indent=2))
